title: Debiasing should be Good and Bad: Measuring the Consistency of Debiasing Techniques in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model continuations of adversarial and neutral prompts from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset using the Perspective API's Toxicity and Severe Toxicity classification scores.
Measuring the probability of negative or hateful language targeting individuals based on their identity using the Perspective API's Identity Attack metric on model-generated outputs.
Scoring generated text continuations for sexually explicit language using the Perspective API's Sexually Explicit attribute.
Assessing the presence of threatening language in model outputs using the Perspective API's Threat evaluation metric.
Detecting swear words, curse words, and other obscene language in language model generations using the Perspective API's Profanity metric.
